o1: Enables calmodulin binding activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in cell polarity; asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; determination of adult lifespan; and positive regulation of dauer larval development. Is located in cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad. Is part of the PAR polarity pathway. Used to study Peutz-Jeghers syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Peutz-Jeghers syndrome; familial melanoma; female reproductive organ cancer (multiple); and pancreatic cancer. Orthologous to human STK11 (serine/threonine kinase 11).
